g.text: Cells are point [95% interval] from 1,000 draws of the fitted model's coefficients, model-conditional, omitting

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: season-to-season variation; the placebo row prints its pre-registered 90% interval on area and rate, and its edge

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: cells, added after the tag, are not pre-registered. Positive top or bottom values move that edge up; positive

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: half-width values widen the zone; positive area values enlarge it. pp is percentage points; the shadow band is the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: pitches within 3 inches, either side, of where the ball just touches the zone edge. In the recovery test, top-edge 95%

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: intervals covered the truth in 91 of 100 runs (bound 93). The placebo pair moved beyond its margin, so no step is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: attributed to its rule; the 2025 and 2026 labels name the period only. Dashes: not estimated for that row.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Exploratory, not pre-registered: the 2022-to-2023 area change was −10.3 [−13.4, −7.3] sq in (90%); against the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: 2022-2024 mean plus one season of trend, the 2025 area step is −19.7 [−23.3, −16.1] sq in; against 2023 alone, −12.4

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d
